summary: Faraday Future filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026, disclosing that total stockholders' equity of $1.412 million as of June 30, 2026 fell below Nasdaq's $2.5 million Equity Standard under Rules 5550(a) and 5550(b)(1). The company states it regained compliance as of July 31, 2026 and continuing, via reductions in notes payable, derivative call option liability, and accounts payable. Nasdaq will keep monitoring; failure to evidence compliance at the next periodic report could trigger delisting. A press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1. Watch for the next periodic report's equity figure and any Nasdaq notice.
